instructions.name: claim_tokens
docs: Exchange a funding receipt for tranche tokens.

instructions.name: clear_vault
docs: Close the window, run the launch gate, and lock rates.

accounts.name: alpha_mint
docs: One mint per tranche per vault. A default in one vault cannot reach
holders in another.

instructions.name: commit
docs: Commit capital to a tranche. Rates shown during the window are
indicative and non-binding.

accounts.name: commitment
docs: A non-transferable receipt. Tranche tokens are not minted until
clearing, because before clearing the rate does not exist.

instructions.name: declare_loss
docs: Record a realized loss and run the waterfall.

instructions.name: disburse
docs: Release capital to the borrower.

accounts.name: treasury_token
docs: PRISM's fee destination. Not written to here: the fee is charged on the
coupon, so it is collected from repayments rather than at drawdown.
Left immutable so a borrower who is also the treasury does not trip
Anchor's duplicate-mutable-account check.

instructions.name: freeze_pool
docs: Halt trading on a distressed vault; price discovery moves to auction.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Create protocol config with documented defaults.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Open a pool for a tranche pair. Gated to Forge-registered mints.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Pool creation is gated to Forge-registered mints. Left permissionless,
anyone could list a counterfeit `pALPHA` and drain buyers who do not
verify mint addresses.

instructions.name: init_vault
docs: Open a vault and start the funding window.

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: The underlying stablecoin. Tests mint a local token; production passes
canonical USDC.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow. Holds committed USDC until disbursement, and repayments until
redemption.

instructions.name: mature_vault
docs: Mark the loan repaid and open redemption.

instructions.name: quote
docs: Publish accrued redemption value per tranche.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burn tranche tokens and pay out.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Reclaim capital from a cancelled vault.

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Burn LP shares for a pro-rata slice of both reserves.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Borrower repayment into escrow.

instructions.name: swap
docs: Swap along the constant-product curve. `min_out` bounds slippage.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Tune policy parameters. Existing vaults keep their frozen rates.

types.name: Commitment
docs: A non-transferable receipt issued during the funding window.
Tokens are not minted until clearing, because before clearing the rate does
not exist — there is no determinate claim to tokenize.

fields.name: redeemed
docs: Set once the holder has redeemed, to prevent double-claims.

fields.name: payout
docs: Recorded at redemption, for auditability.

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-level policy. Every field here was a hard-coded constant until an
operator needed to tune it per market; the constants remain the defaults.
These are judgement calls, not derived values. The ALPHA floor in
particular is a defensible default, not a measured one — revisit it once
there is real loss data.

fields.name: risk_free_bps
docs: Benchmark a lender could earn without credit risk.

fields.name: lambda_bps
docs: Risk premium multiplier, in bps. 3_500 = lambda of 0.35.

fields.name: alpha_floor_bps
docs: Minimum first-loss depth. A tranche thinner than the losses it must
absorb protects nobody.

fields.name: mint_a
docs: Ordered canonically so a pair maps to exactly one PDA.

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: Per-pool LP mint. A share is a claim on a fraction of both reserves.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Swap fee in bps, retained by the pool for its liquidity providers.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Set when the underlying vault is distressed. An AMM cannot price a
defaulted loan: liquidity providers withdraw as default becomes likely,
so the bid vanishes exactly when holders need it.

fields.name: value_bps
docs: Per-token value in bps of face, indexed by seniority. 10_500 = 1.05.

fields.name: committed
docs: Capital committed to this tranche.

fields.name: mint
docs: This vault's mint for this seniority.

fields.name: clearing_bps
docs: Rate set once at clearing, immutable thereafter.

fields.name: attach_low_bps
docs: Loss band, in bps of principal. ALPHA attaches at 0.
A tranche absorbs losses falling between attach_low and attach_high.

fields.name: loss
docs: Principal destroyed by the waterfall, in base units.

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: The underlying stablecoin. Test deployments use a locally minted token;
production replaces this with canonical USDC.

fields.name: vault_authority_bump
docs: PDA that signs every transfer out of escrow.

fields.name: disbursed
docs: Set once the borrower has drawn down. Prevents a second disbursement.

fields.name: repaid
docs: Principal the borrower has repaid so far.

fields.name: principal_target
docs: Target raise, in the underlying token's base units.

fields.name: coupon_bps
docs: What the borrower pays, in bps. e.g. 1400 = 14%.

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: PRISM's cut off the top, in bps. e.g. 200 = 2%.

fields.name: funding_deadline
docs: Unix timestamp after which no further commitments are accepted.

fields.name: activated_at
docs: Set at clearing; accrual starts here.

fields.name: term_seconds
docs: Loan tenor in seconds. Accrual reaches the full clearing rate at term.

fields.name: total_committed
docs: Sum of all commitments across every tranche.

fields.name: realized_loss
docs: Realized portfolio loss, in base units. Set when a loss is declared.

fields.name: tranches
docs: Per-tranche book, indexed by seniority (0=ALPHA, 1=CORE, 2=PRIME).

constants.name: ALPHA_CAP_BPS
docs: Caps concentration regardless of how much demand arrives for high yield.

constants.name: ALPHA_FLOOR_BPS
docs: A thin first-loss tranche protects nobody: a 2% ALPHA tranche is wiped by a
2% loss, leaving CORE and PRIME exposed to risk they did not price.

constants.name: BPS_DENOM
docs: Basis points denominator.

constants.name: DEFAULT_LAMBDA_BPS
docs: Risk premium multiplier. 3_500 = lambda of 0.35.

constants.name: DEFAULT_RISK_FREE_BPS
docs: Benchmark a lender could earn without credit risk. Tokenized treasuries
sat at 4-5% when this was chosen.

constants.name: DEFAULT_TERM_SECONDS
docs: Default loan tenor: 12 months.

constants.name: MAX_COUPON_BPS
docs: Sanity bound on borrower coupon.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Sanity bound on the platform fee.

constants.name: SWAP_FEE_BPS
docs: AMM swap fee, in bps.

constants.name: TRANCHE_MINT_SEED
docs: One mint per tranche per vault. `pALPHA-LF3` and `pALPHA-AB2` are distinct
assets: a default in one vault cannot reach holders in another.

constants.name: VAULT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Signs every transfer out of the vault's escrow.
